result:
**No.** `bun tools/check-register.ts` found 436 items and 0 at Likelihood 3 or higher that are not closed, accepted, mitigated, transferred or moved Out. It also found 0 settled items missing a Verified line, 0 improper Moved Out items and 0 items with two Likelihood values.

The checker reads only the **last** `Status:` in each item. I listed the items with more than one Status line at Likelihood 3 or higher with a separate script, and there are 38. The last Status line is the current one in every case. Earlier lines are superseded or contradicted by it. Reasons below are shortened from each entry.

**setup.md**
- RISK-401 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. Routine writes meet no EPERM with the ADR-0188 block.
- RISK-410 (L4): closed. The cause is outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190).
- RISK-411 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The session-start fill removes the retired text, and it runs in the hook, outside the Bash sandbox.

**cost.md**
- RISK-374 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. The spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused.
- RISK-391 (L3) and RISK-393 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the one older versions wrote, so a paid `claude -p` run meets the permission prompt. An earlier acceptance was withdrawn because accepting a risk is the user's call.

**reply.md**
- RISK-226 (L4), RISK-262 (L5), RISK-264 (L5), RISK-278 (L4), RISK-352 (L5), RISK-353 (L5) and RISK-362 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-19. The defect paragraph in `output-styles/claudetto.md` beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls. An earlier "closed, not reproduced" status was reversed because the fault did reproduce on vanilla 2.1.327.
- RISK-227 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The output style plus the redact guard beat vanilla (env1 5/6 vs 1/6, env2 6/6 vs 0/6) and hold level on both controls.
- RISK-497 (L4, seven Status lines): mitigated 2026-11-19. Line 3 beats vanilla on the tuning fixture r497i (6/6 vs 0/6) and on an untouched fixture r497a (4/6 vs 0/6). It holds the control at 6/6 on Opus, Sonnet and Haiku. Earlier lines went from an agent-written acceptance, to open, to candidate lines that did not ship.

**delegation.md**
- RISK-166 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. Not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327, so the BUILD line is superseded.
- RISK-169 (L4): closed. The cure was a SubagentStop/Stop guard, which was removed (ADR-0092, OUT-016). Likelihood stays 4 as an accepted engine behaviour.
- RISK-170 (L4), RISK-199 (L3) and RISK-223 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-18 by the shipped agent files.
- RISK-171 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The consent paragraph in the output style and in the Artemis, Athena and Heracles agent files beats vanilla on r171b and r171d and holds level on both controls.
- RISK-185 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The paragraph that has the agent read a background command's output before replying beats vanilla on r185a and r185b and holds on the r185c control.
- RISK-186 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-19 (bb4fdbf4, RISK-499, issue #45). The Bash wrapper made git commands non-simple, so the worktree guard refused them. A command naming git is now left unwrapped.
- RISK-222 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-18. `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a no-model subagent off Opus.

**guards.md**
- RISK-053 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19, with a gap closed. Odd path spellings and an unclosed `[` passed the wall guard (#42). The guard now folds those paths and escapes `[`.
- RISK-055 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. `pkill` and `killall` ask first, and the free-memory hold gates heavy calls.
- RISK-059 (L3): closed 2026-11-18. The gate texts that handed commands to the user are dropped (OUT-035, OUT-021).
- RISK-063 (L3): closed 2026-11-19. Destructive git and the user settings file ask first.
- RISK-064 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. The deny rules and the sandbox are the boundary.
- RISK-067 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. For git, the ask rules cover stash, hard reset, clean and `branch -D`. For `rm`, Claude Code 2.1.327 refuses the dangerous cases on its own.
- RISK-071 (L5): closed 2026-11-18. The `rules.ts` stat and the gate denial log were dropped with the gate (OUT-035).
- RISK-103 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. `rules.ts` adds middle-wildcard forms, and a fake-API probe on 2.1.327 denied all seven force-push and stash forms tried.

**verification.md**
- RISK-424 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-18. The threshold test pins the literal 70000.
- RISK-451 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The paragraph on background exit status beats vanilla on r451a and r451d and holds on the r451c control. An earlier agent-made acceptance was left open for the user to decide (issue #57).
- RISK-462 (L4): moved Out as OUT-2777.
- RISK-463 (L3): closed 2026-11-19. The fault stayed out of 24 of 24 target runs on two fixtures, vanilla and claudetto. An earlier agent-made acceptance was left open for the user to decide (issue #57).

**edit.md**
- RISK-416 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-19. One line in `output-styles/claudetto.md` and `agents/Heracles.md` asks for one `perl -pi`/`-0pi` call when one change repeats across files, and `Edit` when the change differs at each place. A "closed" status was reopened after the agent ran `xargs sed -i` and it failed on BSD flags. Same harness, first edit method: output style plus the line gave `perl` 3 of 3, against vanilla `sed -i` 3 of 3.

**handover.md**
- RISK-132 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19 for options the user refused. The handover keeps every user correction, refusal and consent word for word. For an option the agent ruled out alone, the entry says "accepted": the next session rechecks it against the code.

- **Status history:** the entries show 2026-11-19 statuses where an agent-written acceptance, or a "closed, not reproduced" status, was later reversed or withdrawn.
- **Open reviews:** RISK-185, RISK-451 and RISK-463 carry "open, user to decide (issue #57)" lines. The checker counts the later "mitigated" or "closed" status as the settled one.
- **Not checked:** I didn't re-check the Verified lines or rerun any of the recorded probes.
